title: StackChan pt-BR (Brazilian Portuguese) language request for the AI agent

hardware.notes: No physical unit used; the request concerns the Flutter app's Agent Setting page and the remote voice catalog, which a device run does not exercise

firmware.notes: Firmware UI language Kconfig already provides LANGUAGE_PT_PT; locales assets are fetched from upstream xiaozhi-esp32 and are not in this repository

execution.environment: macOS; read-only sparse clone of app/firmware/server; local Device Service device-list query only (no session); no xiaozhi account credentials used

language_flow.display_name_map: app/lib/util/value_constant.dart (pt at :180); unknown keys fall back to the raw code
language_flow.server_side_catalog: server/internal/xiaozhi/xiaozhi.go reuses api/user/tts-list; server/internal/service/agent.go unions languages + tts_voices keys

checks.name: Issue state and existing replies
checks.detail: OPEN, 0 comments at 2026-11-25; no prior m5agent reply

checks.name: Language picker source in Agent Setting
checks.detail: languageList is built from tts_voices keys and rendered as the picker items; selected value is the key

checks.name: Display-name map is not a capability list
checks.detail: Only two call sites, both display-name lookups with raw-code fallback; no filtering or gating

checks.name: Catalog origin and agent submission path
checks.detail: App queries https://xiaozhi.me/api/user/tts-list and posts language to api/agents; token is issued by the StackChan server

checks.name: Server-side catalog handling
checks.detail: Same upstream endpoint; default-agent restore unions languages + tts_voices keys (slightly wider than the app dropdown)

checks.name: Firmware UI Portuguese option
checks.detail: LANGUAGE_PT_PT maps to pt-PT locales; this is device UI text, not agent ASR/TTS language

checks.name: Unauthenticated catalog read
checks.detail: 401 {"success":false,"message":"No token provided"}; real language keys not observable without an account token

checks.name: Local Device Service StackChan profile
checks.detail: stackchan profile present: simulated, ILI9342C 320x240, touch, backend_ready

checks.name: Virtual-device validation
checks.detail: The stackchan profile reproduces firmware runtime only; it does not run the Flutter app page or hold a xiaozhi token

checks.name: Hardware validation
checks.detail: No physical unit; the language catalogue is remote and account-scoped

checks.name: Flutter app build/run
checks.detail: No app build; UI behaviour derived from source only

checks.name: Portuguese TTS/ASR capability on the account
checks.detail: Requires an authenticated catalogue read; not attempted without credentials

limits: code-level verification only; no hardware or virtual-device run
the live voice catalogue could not be read (401 without token)
